note: Which tables hold eMithran reference data (rates, lookups, process and material knowledge: eMithran intellectual property). Built from `npm run migrations:inventory` (step 4 of the on-premises plan). From migration `noNewRowsAfter` on, migrations may change these tables' schema but must not write their rows: reference data ships in versioned, licensed data packages (step 5). `shared` tables hold eMithran rows AND customer rows with no reliable marker of which is which; they need a provenance column before they can be packaged. Checked by src/common/migrations/reference-data.spec.ts.

shared.public.calculators: global calculators have user_id IS NULL; customers' own have a user_id or organization_id
shared.public.costing_settings: eMithran defaults and per-environment overrides in one table
shared.public.mhr_records: global rows are marked three different ways (is_global, user_id IS NULL, organization_id IS NULL), inconsistently
shared.public.raw_materials: user_id is NOT NULL, so seeded rows are owned by whichever account ran the seed
